title: State transition test vectors
description: Format of test-vectors/state-transitions/*.json. A case is a single transition and tests the graph only. A sequence is a path whose every step must be allowed (expected=allowed) or at least one step must be rejected (expected=rejected); for sequences the consent abstraction of the guards also applies: a step whose guard needs consent is allowed only if WAITING_FOR_CONSENT was entered after the last clear_consent effect (a sequence starts without consent). Exact guard evaluation is tested by test-vectors/guards/. State names in rejected vectors may be unknown on purpose.

starts_at_initial.description: Default true for lifecycle machines: an allowed sequence starts at the initial state. Set false for a fragment that starts mid-way.
